implementation.preview_policy: The existing inert CSSOM preview policy is shared by the main renderer and popout renderer; CSS rules are parsed with media disabled, scoped to the host surface, and unsafe imports, URL assets, privileged selectors and document-level rules remain withheld.
implementation.popout_host: The child window loads the vault appearance through the same read-only preload API, applies configured theme/snippet assets to a body.mod-popout workspace surface, preserves configured mode/accent/font-size values and exposes a live read-only appearance status.
implementation.sender_guard: Appearance IPC validates tracked popout senders against the active vault before returning configuration; the main renderer retains its existing access path.
implementation.scope: Popout theme selectors are scoped to body.mod-popout[data-openobsidian-theme-mode], and the child surface exposes workspace, workspace-leaf-content, view-content and view-header legacy contracts for compatibility review.
